text_original: Bottle gourdThe incidence of gummy stem blight disease was recorded in Kinathukadavu block of Coimbatore district. The disease can be managed by spraying cholorotholonil 75 WP @ 1 kg/ha for two times at weekly interval.Snake gourd Fruit fly infestation was observed in Theni and Dindigul districts. To manage fruit fly, setup methyl euginal trap @ 5/Ac and spray cyantraniliprole 10.26 OD @1.8ml/lit. or Azadirachtin 3000 ppm @5ml/lit.Bitter gourdA field survey was conducted in Bitter gourd field at Narasipuram village, Coimbatore District. Meloidogyne incognita was recorded @ 281 per 200 cc of soil and 43 per 5 g root. Recommendations: Soil application of neem cake @ 250 kg/ha and carbofuran @ 40g / plant was recommended.8.Fruit cropsBananaRugose spiraling whitefly damage was observed in Krishnagiri district. To manage this pest, Remove the weeds and keep the field clean. Removal of affected plant parts (Removal parts to be covered with sack or any material and disposed away from the field). Installation of yellow sticky traps or use yellow colour hard plastic sheet, coated with oil and hang it in the infested area. Spray neem oil (commercial formulation) @ 2 ml / litre (Use hand sprayer and wet the both upper and bottom portion of the leaf completely).The Sigatoka leaf spot is noticed in all banana growing areas of Tamil Nadu. The disease can be managed by removing severely infected one or two lower leaves and buried or burnt. Foliar spray of carbendazim 50% WP @ 500 g/ha or mancozeb 75% WP @ 1 kg/ha at monthly interval is recommended. Alternative spray with propiconazole 25% EC @ 500 ml/ha along with petroleum based mineral oil @ 10 ml/ l is recommended. Add 5 ml of wetting agent like Sandovit or Triton AE or Teepol per 10 lit of spray fluid. A field survey was conducted in Banana fields at Karamadai village, Coimbatore District. Radopholus similis was recorded @ 252 per 200 cc of soil and 26 per 5 g root. Recommendations: Soil application of neem cake @ 250 kg/ha and carbofuran @ 40g / plant around the plant basin was recommended.
